entities.name: Lisa Karčić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lisa Ann Karčić is a Croatian American former professional basketball player. She was a member of the Croatian national team and competed with the team at the 2012 Summer Olympics. In 2011, she won the Icelandic championship with Keflavík.
